The direct-public-company universe is narrow and messy: the clearest names are not defense primes but manufacturing marketplaces, quick-turn factories, and additive-manufacturing platform vendors that could help translate government, defense-prime, or tariff-driven reshoring demand into qualified production capacity. The highest-relevance candidate is Xometry because it most directly matches the administrative-qualification-network hypothesis. Proto Labs is a cleaner quick-turn domestic factory / prototyping exposure. 3D Systems and Stratasys add additive-manufacturing equipment, materials, and defense/aerospace use-case exposure, but require careful verification of actual defense revenue and procurement traction. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
